answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 61012 Country: India Title: Dua for conversation problem Question: I am an engineer and have a job. There is some conversation problem with me. I am unable to explain whatever I know .Due to this, failed most of my job interviews. On the other hand, my brain is sharp. I can grasp things quickly but not able to keep in memory for some days. I forget most of my past events quickly. I forget people names. I am reciting dua "Rabbish Rahli Sadri....." for ten years after fardh namaz. Please advise, what should I do. I am very upset. Answer ID: 61012 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1344/1436/L=01/1437) Consult any Hakim for your treatment. Also recite Ya Qawi (يا قوي) 11 times after each salah while putting your hands on your forehead. Use miswak regularly and recite the Holy Quran extensively. These practices shall sharpen your memory power. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
